description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for interacting with the Amazon VPC Lattice service, including method signatures for various API operations.

classes.name: VPCLatticeClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon VPC Lattice service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: batchUpdateRule
methods.description: Method to batch update rules in VPC Lattice.

methods.name: createServiceNetworkVpcAssociation
methods.description: Associates a VPC with a service network.
